final: WITH counts AS (SELECT r.name AS race_name, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), totals AS (SELECT SUM(race_count) AS total_count FROM counts), shares AS (SELECT c.race_name, c.race_count, 1.0 * c.race_count / t.total_count AS share FROM counts AS c JOIN totals AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT s.race_name, s.race_count, s.share, s.share - a.average_share AS excess_share FROM shares AS s JOIN averages AS a ON a.average_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.average_share
